## Load libraries and establish settings

## Questions

**Q1.** You've been assigned to report a story about the leading reasons the U.S. Food and Drug Administration sends warning letters to companies that make or sell food, drugs, medical devices and dietary supplements. A warning letter is the FDA's formal notice that it has found a significant violation of the law; companies that don't fix the problems can face seizures, injunctions or criminal charges. The FDA [publishes its warning letters online](https://www.fda.gov/inspections-compliance-enforcement-and-criminal-investigations/compliance-actions-and-activities/warning-letters). Load the CSV file in the data folder, which contains the text of a random sample of letters from each year from 2021 onward (the number of letters varies by year). Before you count anything, use what you learned in the pre_lab to remove web addresses and email addresses from the text -- the FDA's letters are full of them. Make a list of unique words from the text column, then following the example in the pre_lab, remove common "stop words" from that list and create a list of the top 10 words containing the percentage of occurrences each word represents. What's the leading word in that answer and, broadly, what do you think the top 10 words describe?
